title: taxiframe
summary: The taxi window now follows the current 384x512 law, exact 58x58 flight-master portrait seat, authored continent art/projection, green current and white reachable node states, one-hop default route lines and full hovered chains, shared-tooltip fares, geographic-distance routing over TaxiPath.dbc, and direct-versus-express activation by the byte-verified direct-edge discriminator. TaxiFrameUiLaw owns the full shell-piece table, portrait/map/close/fallback rectangles, title seat, node extents, route endpoint projection, and quad UVs; GameLoop.Taxi contains no local Vector2 geometry. It also covers range expiry, discovery message/sound, stock rejection text, MainMenu cues, no-path self-close, and flight spline lockout without reopening the NPC map. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: No route lines: the ref/Benilla draw single-hop spokes from the current node plus the full (multi-hop) route on hover via TaxiRouteFrame textures; MSUI draws nothing between nodes
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: TaxiPath routes produce one-hop lines on open and the complete selected route chain on hover, using the stock UI-Taxi-Line art.

openItems.text: No fare display: ref shows the destination cost (GameTooltip money line); MSUI tooltip has name only
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: reachable-node hover publishes the route fare as a coin row through the shared GameTooltip owner lifecycle.

openItems.text: Only two icon states (green current / yellow other): the REACHABLE-white vs DISTANT-yellow distinction is absent
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the current node uses the green icon and reachable nodes use white. Current Benilla's byte verdict proves DISTANT/yellow is a dead branch, so unroutable known nodes are omitted rather than shown yellow.

openItems.text: No CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS path (edge-less multi-hop chain activation) and no SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH first-visit learn handling (registry's two missing opcodes)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: first-visit discovery is handled, and an edge-less resolved route sends the exact express guid/fare/count/full-chain body.

openItems.text: No ERR_TAXINOPATHS error toast on a no-single-hop-destination refusal
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: a map with no one-hop route self-closes and posts the byte-exact ERR_TAXINOPATHS string with its curly apostrophe.

openItems.text: No flight-master portrait on the window's portrait ring
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the bound flight-master entity renders into the current authored TOPLEFT(8,-9), 58x58 portrait region behind the shell ring.

openItems.text: Node placement uses a bespoke bounding-box normalization over the continent's node extents rather than the WorldMapContinent projection - icon positions likely drift from the authored map
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: node placement now uses WorldMapContinent fields 9-12 and the byte-verified cross-axis taxi projection, followed by the bottom-left-to-screen conversion owned by TaxiFrameUiLaw.
